question: Does replacing structural singleton-pair merge scores with feature-distance scores reduce projected-GCN prediction errors at the same global merge budget?
feature_scores: Half squared Euclidean distance between original features or frozen first-layer linear features. Scores are fixed before greedy connected unions, not updated Ward costs.
query_selection: First ten existing queries per class, same queries as the preceding projected-forward study. These are already inspected development queries, not fresh confirmation data.
metrics: binary disagreements with original full model
limits: Global cluster counts should match, but local counts can differ. No claim of matched local compression, search speed, test performance, or multi-merge feature-loss optimality.
decision: Preserve all variants and outcomes. Do not replace authoritative fidelity evaluation or paper numbers. A positive development result requires independent validation before method promotion.
